design_c3_reference.shape: Perception + lock + in-row twin, one pass

cost_estimate.fallback_note: The answer-only fallback (decisions 277 A and 283 A) adds at most 2 contacts per row: planned_model_calls is rows x (2 + 2) = 4320 per arm (program maximum 2160), and the speech-audio cap scales the same way. The FIT cap stays structural (rows x program contacts x endpoints = 8640). The GPU ceiling is unchanged: fallbacks are rare (answer-only, at most 1,024 tokens) and the budget closes every think block.
cost_estimate.formula: expected = rows x [ (P_inst + d x E_B) + n_solver x (S_inst + d x E_B) ] / slots / 3600 with P_inst = 5.48 s and S_inst = 7.45 s (Instruct module column, i2), d = 0.02298 s per generated token (266-E fit), E_B = E[min(reasoning, B)] = 848 tokens at B = 3,072; ceiling = ceil_0.1(expected x 1.3)
cost_estimate.superseded_estimate: the registry's 14 GPU-h counted 8,640 contacts at 22.8 s on the bare prompt; the design's model gives 18.4 GPU-h for two unbounded c4 passes

findings.finding: The engineering design's c3 shape (Perception + lock + in-row twin aa in one flight) cannot be compiled today: rails.consumption_module refuses a supply frame with no supply column ("consumption_module.supply_frame is declared but no supply column is") and rails.supply_variants admits only 1 to 6 candidate arms. The twin is therefore a second cell, request-identical to the arm, flown in the same chain (the 266-E replicate and the cell1 / gepacell twins are the precedent). Two c2 passes cost 4 contacts per row; the in-row c3 costs 3.
findings.remedy: decision 282 may admit a candidate-less twin group; the package is then re-derived with fam.TWIN_SHAPE = in-row.

findings.finding: Native role contacts require preserved wire metadata (reproduction.ojw.native_roles._wire_turn: "metered completion requires preserved wire metadata"), so preserve_wire_responses must be true on the module graph. On the Thinking core the preserved wire bytes carry message.reasoning_content, which therefore lands in the sealed trace on the data root (never in Git, never delivered, never scored). Owner constraint (iii) of 266-E (reasoning text never persisted beyond hashes) cannot hold for a native cell.
findings.remedy: owner acknowledgement, or an engineering change that strips reasoning_content before the wire bytes are sealed (hash semantics change).

findings.finding: At the registered completion cap 4096 the live prompt limit is 17406 tokens (24,576 - 3,072 reserve - 4096 - 2); the measured Solver prompt maximum on the Instruct lock is 14641, so no row is compacted or abstained by compact-or-abstain. At the superseded cap 8,192 the limit would be 13310 and the heaviest rows would be.
findings.remedy: none needed at 4,096; the live phase FIT re-measures on the real supply.

findings.finding: Resolved: the Thinking harness knobs are merged (decision 283 A, master 0e6ffbfd3). The model fragment carries the real keys reasoning_budget_tokens, answer_reserve_tokens, enable_thinking, reasoning_context_policy and forced_close_message_sha256 (pinned to the --reasoning-budget-message value in its server_args); they fold into decoding_params at composition; the baselines declare no thinking_policy (every node thinks); the plan ceiling is rows x (contacts + 2 fallback contacts).
The forced-close sentence is the design's wording of the Qwen3 technical report's stop sentence, flagged unverified in the design (section 1.2 / 6 (d)).
findings.remedy: verify verbatim against arXiv:2505.09388 before a flight pins the fragment; change fam.THINK_BUDGET_MESSAGE and the model fragment together.
